points: Built the web client for a 5-platform (IT Vendors, Businesses, IT professionals, Recruiters & Training Centers) marketplace ecosystem in one shared React codebase.
Built reusable cross-platform modules (dashboard, job board, notification center, billing...) so one implementation serves several platforms.
Shipped subscription billing, promo/QR redeem codes and a freelancer hiring flow end to end against a REST API.
Cut the initial JS bundle by about 92% (2.8 MB to 230 KB) with route-level code splitting, self-hosted fonts and image optimization, raising mobile PageSpeed from 59 to 100.
Used Claude Code as an AI pair programmer for implementation, and owned the architecture, code review, debugging and manual QA of every feature before release.

Rebuilt the website of a Munich private jet charter operator in React, replacing a slow, dated WordPress front end: three-step quote flow, fleet and aircraft pages, service and safety content, and contact page, in light and dark themes.
Developed an accessible airport search (ARIA combobox, full keyboard support) over 9,101 airports, loaded on demand.
Reached Lighthouse 90-95 performance (mobile) and 100 accessibility, best practices and SEO; cut the main JavaScript bundle 38% (155 to 96 kB gzipped).
Built a token-based design system with system-aware theming and replaced three duplicated pages with one data-driven template.

Automated the removal of pool access for weekend-pass holders, replacing a manual process. Wrote a JavaScript script that runs nightly at midnight and filters hundreds of guest records by category, date, time and status, so only expired weekend passes lose access.
Added logging so the manager could review exactly what the script changed each night.

Built a web app for the pool and spa manager that turns a slow, hard-to-navigate reporting process into one click. The manager picks a date and gets every guest who entered, how many times each entered and the daily total, filterable by cabana or bracelet guests, ready to print.
